caseName: J. H. Hines Co. v. Guillot
caseNameFull: J. H. Hines Company, Inc. v. Amet Guillot, Sheriff, etc.
attorneys: Mr. John Dale, with whom Mr. B. F. Young, Mr. John Dale, Jr., and Mr. Wade E. Couvillon were on the brief, for plaintiffs in error. Mr. G. L. Porterie, with whom Mr. J. D. Wilkinson, Mr. W. S. Wilkinson, Mr. C. R. Bordelon and Mr. C. H. Lewis were on the brief, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726.
